meta.name: HMND Design System v0.2
meta.philosophy: frontier, not corporate; recognise, not impress

color.accent-usage-rule: Appears max 4 times per viewport: cursor glow, one word in hero, CTA button, one section marker. Never as a background fill.

display.why: Technical, lab-report credibility. Free, self-hostable, wide weight range. Used by Tangram-adjacent biotech sites — proven in category without being Inter-level overused.
display.usage: H1, H2, logo wordmark, section markers, nav

body.why: Warmer and more human than Plex Mono without being generic — avoids the sterile feel of pairing two mono/geometric faces together.

typography.pairing_rule: Never mix a third font. Numerals in body copy fall back to tabular Plex Mono via font-feature for data/dates only.
typography.measure: 65ch max for body paragraphs — never full-bleed text blocks

spacing.rule: No section ever uses a spacing value outside this scale. No arbitrary px.

grid.hero: asymmetric 7/5 split — headline left-weighted, imagery bleeds right past container edge
grid.who-we-are: 8/4 — prose left, single stat or citation right
grid.approach: full-width numbered list, no cards, hairline dividers between items
grid.vision: 3-up feed cards, but unequal heights (masonry-lite, not uniform grid)
grid.rule: At least one section per page must break the 12-col symmetry intentionally

button-primary.hover: bg shifts to accent, text stays #131311, 200ms ease

nav.style: fixed top, transparent over hero, solid bg+hairline border after 80px scroll
nav.wordmark: logo, scramble-decode easter egg per motion spec

section-marker.style: -> 01, -> 02, -> 03, -> 04 in Plex Mono, accent-colored arrow only
section-marker.position: top-left of each section, outside the 12-col container

cards-vision-feed.border: 1px solid border, no shadow, no radius
cards-vision-feed.hover: border shifts to text color, no lift/scale transform

motion.logo-scramble: chars [A,T,G,C,H], random long-tail interval, <1s, width-locked, one-shot, no loop
motion.hero-cipher: genetic-scramble to resolve, on load only, one-shot
motion.scroll-reveal: fade + 8px translateY, once:true, 400ms ease-out, staggered 60ms per child
motion.cta-magnetic: vanilla JS cursor pull on contact CTA, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
motion.global-caps: max 1 animation family active at once; all motion respects prefers-reduced-motion

imagery.style: matte clay/ceramic biological renders, simulated microscope optics
imagery.treatment: barrel distortion + chromatic aberration, no stock photography, no 3D blobs
imagery.placement: bleeds past container edge in hero, contained within grid elsewhere

exclusions: No Inter, Roboto, Arial, system-ui fallback fonts
No floating 3D blobs or abstract gradient shapes
No drop shadows anywhere - hairline borders only
No rounded corners except pill CTA
No more than 1 hero-level animation trigger
No literal DNA helix or nucleotide graphics
